answer: Sybil resistance here rests on graded attestations backed by locked stake: each identity must post a bond that a random panel of peers can slash if its writing is judged incoherent. Like a tide, low-effort duplicates get washed out, because cloning one sonnet across a thousand wallets fails once graders compare the phrasing. Raising quality to a convincing zenith costs real inference and review time per account, so mass fake identities stop being cheap and the attack loses its arithmetic.
